# Hindia Timur

> Hindia Timur is an Indonesian exporter of spices and specialty agricultural products — including coffee, vanilla, and coconut — connecting smallholder farmers in Indonesia with international buyers. The site provides product information, farmer partnership details, and a quote request tool for exporters and B2B buyers.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://hindiatimur.com/index.html): Company overview, featured products, and contact form.
- [Products](https://hindiatimur.com/products.html): Catalog of export products (coffee, vanilla, coconut, and other spices).
- [Coffee](https://hindiatimur.com/coffee.html): Details on Indonesian coffee sourcing, origin, and varieties.
- [About](https://hindiatimur.com/about.html): Company background and the Farmer Partnership Application for Indonesian growers.
- [Request a Quote](https://hindiatimur.com/exporter-quote.html): Quote request form for international buyers and exporters.
- [FAQ](https://hindiatimur.com/faq.html): Common questions about ordering, export logistics, and partnership.

## Optional

- [Contact / Business Inquiries](mailto:hello@hindiatimur.com): Direct email for partnership, press, or general inquiries not covered by the quote or partnership forms.
